snippet.title: Type or Die. Gameplay Trailer. Final Sentence.
snippet.description:
You have to type — or you lose.
It’s a Battle Royale, but with typewriters — and your goal is to type faster than everyone else.
The demo is already live on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2413950/Final_Sentence/
